posts.title: Camera and Sensor Calibration
posts.description: Researching and calibrating the camera and sensors for the drone. Research involved looking into datasets for detecting strawberries and raspberries, as well as identifying plant health. This research is ongoing and we have made considerations to develop our own dataset in the future.

posts.title: Initial Drone Assembly
posts.description: We started putting together the frame. The carbon fiber structure is incredibly sturdy and lightweight. Parts still have to arrive, and much more progress has been made outside of the drone's frame.

posts.title: Project Planning
posts.description: Deep research and planning period for the drone project. Looked into drone parts, existing solutions, what we could do better, and our end goals. We made a comprehensive list of everything we needed and set a plan to get there. Spoke with JAL Berry Farms to understand their needs and concerns and how we could help them.
